_instructions: Copy this file to ~/.claude/settings.json (or merge it into your existing one).
Replace every <ROOT> placeholder with the absolute path to your workspace root.
Replace <YOUR-TRACKER-HUB-PATH> with the absolute path to your tracker hub (on a single-repo start this is simply <ROOT>/Claude).
The Stop hook passes the write-back gate its two paths via env vars on the command line - filling THIS file configures that gate completely; the script-level placeholders are a backstop only.
The git gate printf message names YOUR hard lines - replace <YOUR-HARD-LINES> with
the push and commit constraints that apply in your workspace.
The hooks block is the governance wiring; preference settings regenerate from use.
The git gate's command detection is grep-based and best-effort - a speed bump, not a security boundary; pair it with permission rules for anything that must be impossible.

hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | grep -oE '"command":"[^"]*' | head -1); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(git +(commit|push|tag|merge|rebase|reset --hard|checkout --)|--amend|--force)' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'CLAUDE_REVIEWED'; then printf '<YOUR-HARD-LINES>\nRe-issue with the CLAUDE_REVIEWED=1 prefix (PowerShell: $env:CLAUDE_REVIEWED=1; git ...).\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
